description:
Perform a time series forecast on airline passenger data. 

1. Open the file '~/Documents/JASP/AirlinePassengers.csv' (it contains columns 'Month' and 'Passengers').
2. Enable the 'Prophet' module (click the '+' icon in the top-right module ribbon and check 'Prophet').
3. Using the Prophet > Forecasting analysis, set 'Passengers' as the Dependent Variable and 'Month' as the Time variable.
4. Set the number of periods to forecast to 12 (months).
5. Ensure the analysis runs and produces a plot.
6. Save the results as '~/Documents/JASP/PassengerForecast.jasp'.
